hints.title: Test an angle in each allowed quadrant
hints.body: Find the quadrants where tangent is positive. Choose a simple exact angle from each and test the conjectured inequality.
hints.recap: A counterexample must satisfy the given condition as well as break the conclusion.
hints.pitfall: A check in just one quadrant does not cover every allowed angle.
hints.pause: If a test fails, substitute that same angle into the proof line by line.

recall.reminder: A counterexample must satisfy the given condition as well as break the conclusion.

solution:
Line I is valid: tanθ>0 and cosθ≠0 imply tanθcos2θ>0, equal to sinθcosθ. Lines II–IV then correctly add, use sin2θ+cos2θ=1, and factorise.

Line V is invalid. From (sinθ+cosθ)2>1, we obtain sinθ+cosθ>1 or sinθ+cosθ<−1.

For example, θ=225∘ has positive tangent but sinθ+cosθ=−2. The first error is V: F.
knowledgePattern: Identify the invalid sign choice after a squared inequality
